optionsPrivacyDetail.message: Chrome Voice Mode creates no Speech Provider request from Speak-O. Cloud Voice Mode sends only the submitted source text directly to your selected provider using its credential. Preferences stay in local extension storage; active audio uses session storage and is cleared by Chrome when the extension session ends.
